international.title: French police officers found guilty of racist assault on black music producer
international.summary: Beating of Michel Zecler in 2020 sparked outrage over police brutality after it was caught on security cameras Three French police officers who beat a black music producer they said was not wearing a face mask during the Covid pandemic have been found guilty of intentional, racist violence. The brutal assault on Michel Zecler, now 47, was caught on security cameras in his building in 2020 and triggered outrage in France over police brutality. The trial this month was considered a turning point for the recognition of racist violence. Continue reading...
